PageReaderEnabled.description: Site-wide kill switch. LocalSettings-only; not overridable via MediaWiki:PageReader-config.

PageReaderActions.description: Request actions eligible for the read-aloud module.

PageReaderContentModels.description: Content models eligible for the read-aloud module.

PageReaderNamespaces.description: Namespaces that are always eligible. Default (1004) is Saintapedia's Kids namespace.

PageReaderTitlePrefixes.description: Titles whose prefixed text starts with any of these strings are eligible.

PageReaderPages.description: Titles that exactly equal, or are a subpage of, any of these are eligible.

PageReaderExcludedNamespaces.description: Namespaces excluded even if otherwise eligible. Checked before the allow-lists.

PageReaderExcludedPages.description: Pages excluded even if otherwise eligible (same match rule as PageReaderPages).

PageReaderLoadEverywhere.description: If true, ignore PageReaderNamespaces/TitlePrefixes/Pages and load on every page passing the other gates.

PageReaderContentClass.description: CSS class marking the element to read aloud. An editor can place it anywhere in any article. Default matches the class already used in existing Saintapedia Kids: articles (ported from the prior Common.js implementation) so removing Common.js does not silently make the button stop appearing.

PageReaderContentSelector.description: Fallback CSS selector used when no PageReaderContentClass element is found. Empty = no fallback.

PageReaderSkipSelectors.description: Elements stripped from a clone of the content root before reading textContent.

PageReaderConfigPage.description: MediaWiki:-namespace JSON page (requires editinterface to edit) that can override: namespaces, titlePrefixes, pages, excludedNamespaces, excludedPages, loadEverywhere, contentClass, contentSelector, skipSelectors, buttonPlacement. PageReaderEnabled, PageReaderActions, PageReaderContentModels, and PageReaderIncludeTalk are LocalSettings-only and cannot be overridden here. Empty string disables the overlay.
